title: Private deployments: Release-notes comms matrix and customer enablement handoff (RBAC / KMS / Audit logs)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a single-source release-notes communications matrix, engineer/ops handoff checklist, and customer enablement timeline specific to Private/VPC/on-prem features: RBAC, audit logs, and KMS integrations.

Deliverables:
- Finalized release-notes content for product site and developer changelog.
- Comms matrix mapping audience, channel, owner, and send-window.
- Internal enablement playbook for Sales/CS/Support with runbooks and post-go-live observability links.
- Engineering handoff artifacts (upgrade notes, migration steps, rollback conditions).

Scope constraints: Only covers feature surface for RBAC, audit logs, and KMS for Private deployments (VPC and on-prem) for the March release. Does not include Dedicated pricing copy or external partner marketplace listings (those will be separate).
tasks: Draft canonical release-notes entry (dev-facing + customer-facing) - owner: Jordan
Populate comms matrix spreadsheet with audiences (trial users, enterprise customers, partners, docs subscribers) - owner: PM Ops
Coordinate legal/marketing review for compliance statements and data residency language - owner: Legal
Produce enablement slide deck and 30-min training script for CS - owner: Enablement
Create engineering upgrade checklist and one-click rollback steps - owner: ENG oncall
Link observability dashboards and SLO changes in Console runbook - owner: Observability eng
Publish staged notes to staging docs site and get stakeholder sign-off - owner: Docs
acceptance_criteria: Release notes copy approved by Product, Legal, and Docs
Comms matrix populated with owners and scheduled send-dates in the calendar
Sales/CS enablement materials uploaded to internal drive and a 30-min training scheduled
Engineering upgrade checklist validated in staging and linked in the release PR
Security review completed and KMS/RBAC/Audit statements approved
Post-release monitoring dashboard and escalation contacts documented
updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting with Eng, Docs, Legal, Marketing. Identified primary risk: wording around 'customer-managed keys' and SLA language.
2025-02-18: Draft release-notes (developer-facing) uploaded to Google Doc (link below) for initial review. Requested Legal input on cryptography statements.
2025-02-25: Engineering provided upgrade checklist v0.2; added rollback step for KMS key rotation error case. ENG owner flagged item for SRE validation.
2025-03-01: Marketing review complete; suggested two variants of customer-facing notes (concise vs. technical). Decided to publish both under separate headings.
2025-03-02: Security review kickstarted; need proof of KMS HSM integration and audit log retention policy before sign-off. Blocker: HSM vendor certification doc pending.
review_feedback: Legal (M. O'Neill): Add explicit data-residency sentence and avoid implying a managed KMS promise.
Security (L. Becker): We need artifact proving HSM FIPS 140-2 certification before public wording references HSM.
Docs (S. Ramirez): Suggest separating technical migration steps into an 'Upgrade Appendix' to keep customer-facing notes concise.
Support (R. Chen): Recommend adding canned responses and internal triage rubric for common KMS/key rotation issues.
risk_mitigation: If HSM certification or legal sign-off delays occur, fallback plan is to ship RBAC + audit logs with 'customer-managed keys (bring your own key) - beta' language and gate KMS HSM copy behind a feature flag. Schedule a targeted customer webinar and extended CS monitoring window for the first 14 days post-release.
notes_for_release_manager: Coordinate final docs freeze two business days before release, ensure comms owners have calendar holds for send windows, and confirm SRE oncall is present during the first 6 hours post-deploy. Prepare a short post-mortem template to be filled within 3 days if any P1/P2 incidents occur.
communication_windows: T-2 business days: Internal announcement (all-hands comms) - owner: Marketing
T-1 business day: Customer-facing release notes published on docs site - owner: Docs
Day 0 (release day): Email to enterprise accounts and partners - owner: Sales Ops
Day +1: CS enablement session and Slack AMA - owner: Enablement
Day +7: Follow-up adoption metrics and targeted outreach for high-risk customers - owner: CS Analytics
